text: We are operating on about one-sixteenth of the relational density our biology requires (Perry, 2023). The "Void" you feel is real. Once you have de-armored, you cannot simply return to a lonely life. You must aggressively engineer a "High-Density" social environment (A Tribe), or the brain will eventually reach for the armor again just to survive the cold.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware.
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what
